key_points: WDC guided to $5.1B quarterly revenue and up to 61% gross margins on Nov 11, driving a ~9% stock jump

Capital Group purchased $39.6M of WDC on Nov 13 while rotating out of Nvidia, signaling institutional support
Mixed analyst commentary: bullish brokerage recommendations but 'value trap' concerns given 60% decline
No earnings surprise or guidance change beyond the Nov 11 pre-announcement; near-term volatility likely
